play_equipment.evidence: There is a round light-colored object on the patio east of the house, but it looks like a patio umbrella or table, not a trampoline.

detached_structure.evidence: A dark-roofed structure sits south-southwest of the central house, partly under trees. It may be a detached garage or outbuilding. A semicircular curved feature lies beside it.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray hip-style roof with a skylight or vent and moderate shading. A dense tree canopy covers the south and east sides of the lot, and a patio with an umbrella sits east of the house.
